A Read the following sentences:
- Who is she?
- I don't know her. Sorry.
- I know her.
- She lives near my place.
- She is Meghna.

This is my bag. Where is yours?
- Here is mine. And this is Uttom's.
- But I don't see our passports.
- This is my passport. Is it your passport?
- Oh, yes. Thank you.

| Subject pronoun | Object pronoun | Possessive adjective | Possessive pronoun |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I | me | my | mine |
| you | you | your | yours |
